scientific_limitations_and_integrity.claim_scope: For every \(n\ge5\), countably infinite rank in \(\widetilde H_4\) and \(\widetilde H_7\) of the inclusive scale-three Vietoris-Rips complex of the Manhattan integer lattice.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.integrity: No finite enumeration is used as proof of the all-dimensional statement; no independent audit or external validation is claimed.
limitations: Does not determine torsion in \(\widetilde H_4\) or \(\widetilde H_7\).
Does not determine homology in other degrees.
Does not prove the full wedge-of-spheres homotopy type asked about in the cited lattice paper.
scientific_limitations_and_integrity.proof_basis: Uniform proof using the published scale-three binary-hypercube homotopy theorem, coordinatewise 1-Lipschitz clamp retractions, and a finite-chain argument establishing a split direct summand.

title: Infinite-rank degree-four and degree-seven homology at scale three on integer lattices
